disclose: The released fonts are partly hinted (TrueType instructions in 5852 to 5856 of 14695 to 14697 glyphs per style). These sources carry no TrueType instructions, so the build is hinted by ttfautohint: the outlines, spacing and layout are the releases', its rendering at small sizes under a TrueType interpreter is not. Hinting is not compared by the gates.
